summary: Lower global fetch to a Web-compatible host runtime that preserves Fetch networking, redirects, CORS, credentials, cache, and Promise behavior.

semantics.request: constructs/derives a Fetch Request before network fetch
semantics.network: HTTP semantics, redirects, credentials, CORS, cache, referrer and policy are host/runtime responsibilities
semantics.errors: network/fetch failures reject the promise; ordinary HTTP error statuses resolve to Response

caveats: HttpClient.SendAsync alone is not Fetch: browser CORS/redirect/header/filtering/body-stream semantics remain observable.

tests.name: HTTP status is not promise rejection
tests.input: // A host test should return a 404 response and assert fetch resolves with response.ok === false.
tests.expected_behavior: 404/500 HTTP responses resolve normally; only fetch/network failures reject
